key.mcbilingual.freeze_ui: Freeze interface and look up the other language
config.mcbilingual.compat_modes: Compatibility modes. Empty means every mod is Full. One line is modid=Full, modid=Generic, or modid=Off. Full runs the dedicated compatibility. Generic skips that dedicated code; text that behaves like vanilla may still be bilingual. Off disables this mod on that mod's own screens and overlays. Vanilla content on the same screen stays available.
